verdict.rationale: SvelteKit documents that route pages are server-rendered, that rendering modes can be mixed per page, and that the framework is comparable to Next/Nuxt. A community user also notes it is clear what loads on the server versus the client, which implies server-side data loading feeding the rendered components. Nothing in the pack shows asynchronous server components that fetch data and pass it to interactive client components. missing for 10: documentation of async server-rendered components or the server data-loading API, an explicit server-to-client data handoff and hydration mechanism, and hands-on corroboration of the pattern.
